items.docs:
Returns a list of form libraries to which the current user has access.

## Permissions

All users can use this method, but the results will differ based on whether the company has asked DocuSign to enable **RequireOfficeLibraryAssignments** functionality. If this functionality is enabled for the account, then the list is filtered based on the offices that the user is in and the libraries that are assigned to those offices.
